name: volibear-noaurora-cards-b-race1-kai-sa-01-jason-t
description: Round 1b of the Volibear search without Dazzling Aurora (13 Nov), entirely with the cheap pilot (sims=4, worlds=2) on the session's machine: the card model on every explored game so far (about 270,000), candidates built from round 1's confirmed lists, then races. Its leaders join round 2's starting lists; nothing here is a rating. Stage race1: 13 lists on the same seeds, 2400 games per list shared out by the opponents' weights. This request: Kai'Sa (Jason Tian), 496 games.
